developmentNote: Added ideal additive phase volumes solely for reference layout, closed liquid cavities, cached sphere topology and analytic normals. Reused unit grain geometry with transforms instead of rebuilding every sphere on each frame. An observed slow/ambiguous pause acknowledgement prompted optimization and retest; a subsequent browser action acknowledgement timed out but a fresh DOM snapshot proved the trial had paused at5.85s with recording enabled. No application error was logged. No measured FPS claim is made.
reviewScope: Internal engineering/model consistency and browser viewport review, not independent expert, official-board, empirical sample/instrument or physical-device certification. Pure reference sucrose/NaCl/NaHCO3/quartz at25°C; household additives excluded. Capacity references preserve solvent units. Common illustrative bulk rate does not predict real-material speed ranking. Rounded enlarged aggregates and prescribed dry-grain cohort flight/compaction; no air drag, collisions, flow, heat, speciation or settling solver. Additive phase-volume layout approximates dissolved specific volume by solid specific volume; no calibrated solution contraction/expansion or density prediction. Liquid mesh volume agrees with this assumed reference volume within0.25cm³ tessellation error. Lower-chamber inspection deliberately crops the upper apparatus. Separate full guides and short1×manual segments checked; full120smanual playback and pointer orbit dragging not recorded.
